issue.title: resource/aws_rolesanywhere_profile: add region argument for enhanced multi-region support
issue.body:
### Description

### Description

The `aws_rolesanywhere_profile` resource does not currently appear to support the enhanced per-resource `region` argument.

AWS IAM Roles Anywhere is a regional service with regional endpoints, and profiles may need to be created in more than one AWS Region. Since Terraform AWS Provider v6 added enhanced `region` support to most resources, data sources, and ephemeral resources, it would be useful for `aws_rolesanywhere_profile` to support the same pattern.

Currently, users who want to create Roles Anywhere profiles across multiple Regions still need to use multiple provider aliases. Adding `region` would allow the resource to be managed consistently with other resources that support per-resource Region targeting.




### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

### Affected Resource(s)

- `aws_rolesanywhere_profile`

### Potential Terraform Configuration

### Expected Behavior

`aws_rolesanywhere_profile` should accept an optional `region` argument.

When `region` is set, the provider should create, read, update, delete, import, and tag the IAM Roles Anywhere profile in the specified AWS Region.

When `region` is omitted, the resource should continue to default to the Region configured on the provider.

Example:

```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

resource "aws_rolesanywhere_profile" "east" {
  region = "us-east-1"

  name      = "example-east"
  role_arns = [aws_iam_role.example.arn]
  enabled   = true
}

resource "aws_rolesanywhere_profile" "west" {
  region = "us-west-2"

  name      = "example-west"
  role_arns = [aws_iam_role.example.arn]
  enabled   = true
}
```

### Actual Behavior

`aws_rolesanywhere_profile` currently rejects `region`:

```text
Error: Unsupported argument

An argument named "region" is not expected here.
```

### Local Investigation

I tested this locally against the provider source.

`aws_rolesanywhere_profile` currently has generated service package metadata similar to:

```go
{
    Factory:  resourceProfile,
    TypeName: "aws_rolesanywhere_profile",
    Name:     "Profile",
    Tags: unique.Make(inttypes.ServicePackageResourceTags{
        IdentifierAttribute: names.AttrARN,
    }),
    Region: inttypes.ResourceRegionDisabled(),
}
```

For local testing only, I changed that generated metadata to:

```go
Region: inttypes.ResourceRegionDefault(),
```

I also added the v6 SDKv2 fix annotation and excluded `names.AttrRegion` from normal update diff handling:

```diff
 // @SDKResource("aws_rolesanywhere_profile", name="Profile")
+// @V60SDKv2Fix
 // @Tags(identifierAttribute="arn")
```

```diff
- if d.HasChangesExcept(names.AttrTags, names.AttrTagsAll) {
+ if d.HasChangesExcept(names.AttrRegion, names.AttrTags, names.AttrTagsAll) {
```

After rebuilding the provider locally, Terraform accepted `region` on `aws_rolesanywhere_profile`.

The plan showed two resources using different resource-level Regions:

```text
# aws_rolesanywhere_profile.east will be created
+ resource "aws_rolesanywhere_profile" "east" {
    + name   = "tf-ra-region-test-east"
    + region = "us-east-1"
  }

# aws_rolesanywhere_profile.west will be created
+ resource "aws_rolesanywhere_profile" "west" {
    + name   = "tf-ra-region-test-west"
    + region = "us-west-2"
  }
```

Apply succeeded:

```text
aws_rolesanywhere_profile.east: Creation complete
aws_rolesanywhere_profile.west: Creation complete

Apply complete! Resources: 3 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.
```

AWS CLI verification showed each profile in the expected Region:

```text
aws rolesanywhere list-profiles --region us-east-1

tf-ra-region-test-east
arn:aws:rolesanywhere:us-east-1:123456789012:profile/...
```

```text
aws rolesanywhere list-profiles --region us-west-2

tf-ra-region-test-west
arn:aws:rolesanywhere:us-west-2:123456789012:profile/...
```

A second Terraform plan was clean:

```text
No changes. Your infrastructure matches the configuration.
```

### Implementation Notes

The generated IAM Roles Anywhere service client already appears to support regional targeting through provider/client configuration. The generated `NewClient` code reads `config[names.AttrRegion]` and applies it to `rolesanywhere.Options.Region`.

The blocking issue appears to be that `aws_rolesanywhere_profile` is configured with:

```go
Region: inttypes.ResourceRegionDisabled()
```

rather than:

```go
Region: inttypes.ResourceRegionDefault()
```

Because `service_package_gen.go` is generated, the final fix likely needs to update the source annotations/generator inputs so that generated service package metadata enables enhanced Region support for `aws_rolesanywhere_profile`.


### References

- `aws_rolesanywhere_profile` generated service package metadata currently disables enhanced Region support:
  https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/blob/main/internal/service/rolesanywhere/service_package_gen.go#L37-L45

- The generated IAM Roles Anywhere client already reads `config[names.AttrRegion]` and applies it to `rolesanywhere.Options.Region`:
  https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/blob/main/internal/service/rolesanywhere/service_package_gen.go#L67-L76

- Comparable resource `aws_acmpca_certificate_authority` uses `Region: inttypes.ResourceRegionDefault()`:
  https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/blob/main/internal/service/acmpca/service_package_gen.go#L67-L78

- `aws_rolesanywhere_profile` create logic uses the regional `RolesAnywhereClient(ctx)` and calls `CreateProfile` without a `region` field in the API input:
  https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/blob/main/internal/service/rolesanywhere/profile.go#L93-L116

- `aws_rolesanywhere_profile` update logic currently excludes only tags from `HasChangesExcept`; local testing required also excluding `names.AttrRegion`:
  https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/blob/main/internal/service/rolesanywhere/profile.go#L170-L188

- AWS CLI `rolesanywhere create-profile` supports regional targeting through the standard `--region` global option:
  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/rolesanywhere/create-profile.html#global-options

- AWS IAM Roles Anywhere API Reference — `CreateProfile` request body does not include a `region` field:
  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/APIReference/API_CreateProfile.html#API_CreateProfile_RequestBody

- AWS IAM Roles Anywhere User Guide — IAM Roles Anywhere resources are regional and must be created in the same account and Region to be used together:
  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/userguide/introduction.html

- AWS General Reference — IAM Roles Anywhere regional endpoints:
  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rolesanywhere.html

- AWS SDK for Go v2 IAM Roles Anywhere package — `NewFromConfig` constructs the service client:
  https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/rolesanywhere#NewFromConfig

- AWS SDK for Go v2 IAM Roles Anywhere package — `Client.CreateProfile` operation:
  https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/rolesanywhere#Client.CreateProfile

### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

Yes
